protocol.features: log10, then training-only min-max to [-1,1] per column; bias 1 appended
protocol.shuffle: NumPy default_rng(42), fresh permutation each epoch
protocol.stop: complete epoch with no updates, or 500 epochs
protocol.trace: state 0 before training; subsequent states after every sample presentation, including no-update steps
protocol.loss: L=0.5*sum_i(y_i-H(z_i))^2 on all 47 training rows after each presentation
protocol.scope: Illustrative full-training-set fit; no validation/test split or generalization claim

histograms.bin_convention: left-closed/right-open, except final bin includes right edge
